name: Coldseam The Burned Spire Judge's Exit Look
description: What a Spire judge wears when they're no longer one: a formal robe stripped of its insignia, rank piping removed with a blade — the ghost-lines of where it sat still visible in the fabric's sheen. Beneath it, a plain high-collar shirt in ash-white, buttoned to the throat. Trousers are Tier 4 cut but worn at the knees. Footwear still immaculate — the last pride. A Vanthorpe ankle monitor on the left leg, court-issue, blinking amber. Hair or head covering severe and unstyled. The whole look reads as someone who was Tier 5 this morning and is deciding what they are tonight.
functionality: Ankle monitor transmits location to GLMZ judicial authority at 30-second intervals; robe retains thermal regulation from original Spire manufacture; high collar conceals BCI port hardware from neural link used in judicial functions.
what_it_says: Power stripped to its skeleton — either a warning or a weapon, depending on what this person knows.
worn_by: characters in narrative transition from power to danger
story_hooks: The robe's insignia was removed by the judge themselves, before the tribunal finished — a statement that still hasn't been explained.
The ankle monitor has been broadcasting a second, encrypted signal no one at Vanthorpe authorized.
Three Tier 5 power brokers have made quiet contact since the sentencing — they want something only this person's judicial memory still holds.

physical_description.visual_profile: A figure of deliberate de-ranking: formal silhouette gutted of authority. The robe drapes like a shed skin, its former importance mapped in pale seams and phantom piping lines. The overall impression is spectral — a person transitioning between worlds, shedding jurisdiction like a molt.
physical_description.fit: Robe is tailored but worn loose, almost theatrical in its surrender. Undershirt is crisp and high-collared, sitting rigid against the neck. Trousers are slim-fitted at the waist but deliberately worn at the knees, signaling active degradation rather than time alone.
physical_description.primary_material: Robe: premium synth-wool in charcoal, now stripped; undershirt: treated linen blend in ash-white; trousers: ballistic weave in dark gray; monitor casing: brushed titanium-composite
physical_description.texture: Robe surface is smooth but marked by visible removal scars — slight pilling where insignia were unpicked, faint creasing from rank piping that no longer exists. Undershirt is crisp with visible thread-tension lines. Knee wear on trousers is authentic fabric breakage, not stylized distressing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal and ash-gray dominant. Ash-white undershirt provides clinical contrast. Left ankle monitor adds amber blink (active status light) — only chromatic accent. Overall palette: desaturated, institutional, mourning.
physical_description.closures: Robe: magnetic snap system (court-standard, now blank-faced). Undershirt: traditional button-front in pewter metal. Trousers: friction-fit waistband with no visible hardware. Monitor: sealed biometric lock, non-removable.
distinctive_features: Ghost-lines of removed rank piping visible in robe fabric sheen
Deliberate absence of judicial insignia — removal marks visible
Vanthorpe Judicial Systems ankle monitor: blinking amber status light, court-issue GPS + bio-signature tracking
Pristine footwear contrasting with degraded garments above — last vestige of authority
High neckline of undershirt creates choking silhouette
Worn-through knee panels on trousers showing underlying weave
No styling, no augmentation jewelry, no accessories
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1→5 transition. The robe was Tier 1 formal wear; its current state is Tier 5 stripped-asset. The monitor is Tier 5 court-issued control.
physical_description.cultural_context: Judicial exile. The wearer is being read in real-time: once had power, lost it this morning. The monitor broadcasts it. No corpo would wear this. No street-tier person would have owned the original robe. This is the uniform of defrocking, of public fall.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn as an act of statement, not time. Fresh removal marks. Trousers deliberately worn at knees — active choice or active wear from pacing. Robe shows no other damage, only intentional stripping. Footwear buffed despite everything else — either habit or defiance.

image_prompt: Neo-noir fashion photograph of a tall figure in a stripped judicial robe, charcoal with visible removal seams, over an ash-white high-collar shirt. Dark trousers worn at the knees. Left ankle displays an amber-blinking Vanthorpe monitor. Immaculate dark shoes. Head unstyled, severe. Figure stands against a GLMZ Spire's brutalist concrete wall, moody blue-gray overhead lighting catching the ghost-lines in the robe fabric. Amber ankle light reflected on floor. The pose is formal but hollowed — judicial authority drained. Cinematic, desaturated palette, high contrast. Shot from mid-thigh up. Dark background. --ar 2:3 --v 6
